In this episode of Waterbreak, Gabe and Annie dive into the dangers of blindly following popular health trends. From diets to exercise routines, what works for one person might not work for you. They explore why understanding your own body type, metabolism, and stress levels is key to finding a sustainable plan for long-term health. Tune in as they break down how to avoid common health mistakes and tailor a strategy that actually works for you.

In this episode of Waterbreak, Sal Di Stefano, host of the Mind Pump podcast, opens up about how his journey through the fitness world led him to a deeper understanding of faith. After years of chasing physical gains and navigating the fitness industry’s lies, Sal realized something was missing—truth. We explore how fitness and spirituality intersect, and how Sal’s personal transformation shifted his focus from chasing aesthetics to embracing faith. If you’ve ever wondered how health, wellness, and faith come together, this episode dives into the real, raw process of living a life that's balanced physically and spiritually.
